load_model_from_file: load a serialized PyTorch model from a file path or dict using load_model
serialize_model_for_saving: serialize a model with its init args and training config using serialize_model
get_quantizer_for_model: create a DiffQuantizer or UniformQuantizer for a model using get_quantizer
swap_model_state_temporarily: temporarily swap a model state within a context manager using swap_state
save_model_with_checksum: save model state to disk with a SHA256 checksum using save_with_checksum
